description: Synthetic sesslint.repair.preconditions parity (module exports, registry order, predicates, check_preconditions, component helpers).
known_parity_gaps: GAP-preconditions-must-abstain: no_prior_safe_tool_after_cut would call sesslint.policy.abstention.must_abstain; Rust returns Unavailable instead of true.
GAP-preconditions-parent-candidates: unique_parent_candidate would call sesslint.checks.graph.find_qualifying_parent_candidates; Rust returns Unavailable.
GAP-preconditions-canonical-json-bytes: fingerprint comparison may call sesslint.determinism.canonical_json_bytes; Rust returns Unavailable where Python returns a bool.
GAP-preconditions-payload-content-hash: fingerprint comparison may call sesslint._canonical_codec.payload_content_hash; Rust returns Unavailable where Python returns a bool.

GAP-preconditions-dunder-all: Python __all__ has 22 names, including types and helpers. precondition_func_names is the 16-name registry. The module_all vector keeps the pin list and does not treat that list as the registry.
